    markdown: "Coralogix Custom Role. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/create-roles-and-permissions/."
description  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Custom Role description."
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Custom Role ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

    markdown: "Custom Role name."
parent_role  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Parent role name"
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
permissions  SetAttribute required elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Custom role permissions"
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
